summary: ACDC #175 选定 EIP-7805 FOCIL 为 Hegotá 共识层头号功能。VitalikButerin 指出 FOCIL 与 EIP-8141 的协同：8141 让智能账户与隐私协议都成为一等公民，FOCIL 再为它们提供抗审查保障。Solidity 0.8.34 修复 0.8.28 至 0.8.33 版 IR 管线的高危漏洞。

items.title: VitalikButerin：FOCIL 与基于 7701 的 AA 提案 EIP-8141 有重要协同，8141 不仅让智能账户（多签、抗量子签名、换密钥、gas 赞助）成为一等公民，也能让隐私协议如此
items.title_en: VitalikButerin: there is an important synergy between FOCIL and AA (EIP-8141, based on 7701); 8141 makes smart accounts, including multisig, quantum resistant signatures, key changes and gas sponsorship, first class citizens, and can do the same for privacy protocols

summary_en: ACDC #175 picked EIP-7805 FOCIL as the Hegotá consensus layer headliner. VitalikButerin highlighted the synergy with EIP-8141: 8141 makes smart accounts and privacy protocols first class citizens, and FOCIL then gives them censorship resistance. Solidity 0.8.34 fixed a high severity IR pipeline bug affecting 0.8.28 to 0.8.33.
